title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: the free side's copying configuration on training seeds 5 to 9
description: The free side's second configuration on more training seeds, in expliCCit's encoder-decoder architecture (an encoder of 1.27 million weights with seven outputs, read by an actor of two layers of 256): encoder and actor cloned together from BBRv3's logged window multipliers, the seven latents free of meaning (lcft-freefix-none, 10,000 updates, as in exp-lcf-cost-teacher-317; seeds 2 to 4 in exp-lcf-cost-teacher-seeds-321). On links 0 to 99 the free side's two configurations are level: exp-lcf-cost-deep-search-337 scored copying -0.290 and TD3+BC -0.303 against BBRv3, while the earlier searches on the same episodes scored TD3+BC -0.176 (exp-lcf-cost-td3-search-327) and copying -0.277 and -0.261 (exp-lcf-cost-teacher-search-318, exp-lcf-cost-td3-search-327). Reruns of the same free policies on the same episodes differ by up to 0.16 per seed, so the gap between the two is within rerun noise. TD3+BC stays the free side's headline configuration by the mean over all three searches (-0.240 against -0.276), and copying is reported beside it on seeds 0 to 9 (with exp-lcf-cost-best-seeds-336 for TD3+BC's seeds 5 to 9), so the answer does not hang on the choice. summary.md lists each policy's training diagnostics.
run: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; O="$OUT/lcft-freefix-none-s$SEED"; mkdir -p "$O"; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --argjson seed "$SEED" '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, controllers: ["bbr3"], net2: {algo: "bc", action: "multiplier", reward: "sage", reward_alignment: "same", action_max: 1.0, action_decimals: 3, steps: 10000, inputs: "raw", encoder: "free"}}' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| policy | transitions | validation BC error | seconds | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/lcft*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.seconds | floor), (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
